system.description:
You create a field of oppressive cutting wind that lashes out against creatures when they attempt Hand Seals (HS). Select a point you can see within range as a field of soft air begins to churn in a 10-foot radius. All creatures in the given radius that casts a jutsu with the Hand Sign (HS) component takes 2d6 Wind damage and must make a Constitution Saving throw gaining the Bleed condition on a failed save.

As a bonus action on your turn, you may move the field up to 20 feet in any direction to a point you can see within range.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, this jutsu gains the Swirl effect. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, this jutsu also triggers if a creature casts a Jutsu with the Mobility (M) component. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, if a creature casts a jutsu with both HS and M components it triggers once, for each property listed.

Swirl. Creatures who would fail their saving throw, spreads all Elemental conditions currently affecting them around to all creatures, excluding the caster within 5 feet of them. Hostile creatures within 5 feet of the failing one gains 1 rank of all elemental conditions currently affecting it.
